Job Summary

The BIM Modeler is responsible for producing accurate, constructible electrical BIM models under the direction of the BIM Coordinator. This role focuses on model quality, data accuracy, and adherence to company and industry standards.

Major Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Use BIM Software to model electrical systems including conduit, lighting, electrical devices, and equipment.

  • Maintain model accuracy through revisions and coordination updates.

  • Apply company and/or project standards for families, parameters, naming conventions, and model data.

  • Generate drawings, schedules, and quantities from internal and external BIM models.

  • Attend regular BIM coordination meetings to support the BIM Coordinator and collaborate on project changes, conflicts and issues.

  • Support electrical prefabrication, layout deliverables, and as-built documentation.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of Revit modeling experience focused on electrical installations.

  • Ability to read and interpret electrical construction documents.

Preferred Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience working for an electrical contractor.

  • Familiarity with Navisworks and Autodesk Construction Cloud.

  • Strong attention to detail.

  • Good communication and teamwork skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines.

Cooper Electrical Construction Co. is looking for Industrial Electricians to join our team. Work will consist of plan layout, alterations, additions and /or repairs of electrical systems, light fixtures, conductors and associated materials and equipment within the commercial, industrial electrical industry. This position reports to the Superintendent.

***Must have minimum five (5) years of experience to be consider an Electrician***

Major Duties and Responsibilities

  • Inspect, repairs, installs, service and maintains electrical systems and sub systems including conduit and duct systems, lighting and power circuits, transformers, control equipment, switches, switchboards, fixtures and bell and buzzer systems; works from plans, drawings, blueprints or specifications.
  • Install new or modified electrical installations consistent with local and national codes.
  • Installs or replaces necessary interior and exterior wiring for equipment, appliances and lighting.
  • Installs and performs repair of electrical systems for lighting, heating, ventilation and air conditioning.
  • Assist in the design, installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of various programmable logical controller (PLC) hardware systems.
  • Measures, cuts, bends, threads, assembles and installs electrical conduit.
  • Follow diagrams, blueprints and interrupt specifications.
  • Demonstrate safe work habits and proper care of equipment and tools.
  • Plan electrical installations to minimize waste of materials.
  • Prepare and present sketches showing location of wiring and equipment.
  • Willing to be on-call in case of emergency.
  • Performs related duties and responsibilities as required.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Technical training in electrical systems; and, four (5) years of experience as an electrician; which includes duties and responsibilities in industrial and controls instrumentation.

Knowledge of:

  • tools, materials, methods and techniques associated with electrical trade.
  • relevant electrical codes.
  • safety rules and regulations.
  • hazards associated with the work.

Ability to:

  • travel out of town or state as needed
  • perform all phases of electrical work.
  • diagnose and troubleshoot defects in all electrical systems and equipment and perform needed repairs.
  • read, understand, and follow safety rules and regulations.
  • perform strenuous physical work.
  • read, interpret and work form a variety of blueprints, drawings, one-line diagrams, sketches, and work orders.
  • proficiently run EMT and RIGID of all sizes from ¾” to 4”.
  • bend offsets, saddles, 90’s and kick with both hand and hydraulic benders.
  • install and terminate panels, switch gears and disconnects.
  • set-up and pull wire-properly numbering the circuits and colors of phases.
  • install a variety of light fixtures
  • run cable tray and bus duct.
  • physically be able to climb ladders and work on your feet 8 to 12 hours per day.
  • physically be able to lift up to 50 lbs.

Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or Trade School Certificate in Electrical Wiring or comparable experience required.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience as a journeyman in the installation, maintenance, and repair of electrical systems, equipment and fixtures using blueprints, schematics and sketches.
  • Demonstrates understanding and enthusiastic agreement with the vision and mission of Cooper Electrical Construction Company.
  • Experience using hand tools, small power tools, large power tools (threaders, benders, etc.).
  • Experience studying work orders, building plans, and installation manuals in order to determine materials requirements and installations procedures.
  • Experience reading contract drawings.
  • Experience installing and mounting electronic controls, device panels, sensors, and components.
  • Experience installing, assembling, testing, and maintaining electrical or electronic wiring, conduit, cable, equipment, components, and devices associated with electrical equipment following drawings of electrical layouts and building plans.
  • Experience performing work at various heights, up to 90 feet from ladders, scaffolds, aerial lifts, catwalks or other safe work areas.
  • Ability to perform interlock wiring as required.
  • Experience testing electrical systems and continuity of circuits in electrical wiring, equipment, and fixtures using testing devices.
  • Ability to appropriately diagnose malfunctions in systems, apparatus, and components using test equipment and hand tools to locate the cause of breakdown and take appropriate steps to correct the problem.
  • Ability to instruct and train workers to install, maintain, and repair electrical wiring, equipment and fixtures.
  • Has a clear understanding of the latest edition of the NEC.

Job Summary

Sr. Electrical Estimator will be responsible for estimating projects, labor and materials cost, and communicating financial cost and project timelines based on specifications/drawings/narratives. Sr. Electrical Estimator must have keen attention to detail, organizational skills, and be able to work in a team environment. This role reports to the CFO/COO.

Major Duties and Responsibilities

  • Develop accurate cost estimates for electrical installation ranging in size from small projects to $40M+
  • Experience in Budgets from narratives.
  • Experience in Pharma, manufacturing, healthcare, industrial and other non-commercial projects.
  • Develop Invitations to Bid and Bill of Materials for estimates.
  • Identify labor, materials, and time requirements by studying proposals, blueprint, specifications, and related documents.
  • Determine and price value-engineered items from plans and specifications.
  • Provide leadership with project “red-flags” and specific constraints for review and consideration before bid submission.
  • Perform budget pricing from schematic or DD drawings and/or narratives.
  • Draft proposal letters for customers
  • Attend job walks, pre-bid meetings, and conferences with clients.
  • Maintain clear and concise bid notes and documentation. Update bid with RFI responses and addendums issued by the client.
  • Review subcontractor and vendor quotes to verify needs of the project.
  • Include proposed project management in bid strategy and pricing.
  • Review bids with senior leadership and owners for input prior to bid submission.
  • Conduct project turnover meeting (page turn) with project manager and superintendent(s) for awarded jobs.

Minimum Requirements

  • 5 Years of Field install experience is preferred but not required.
  • A minimum of 7-10 years of electrical estimating experience on projects in excess of $10M
  • Extensive working knowledge of Accubid estimating software. Experience with Live Count preferred.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office programs such as word, excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with Bluebeam is preferred.
  • A high school diploma or GED is required, but a Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or similar studies is preferred.
  • Be able to work in a calm and organized manner within project deadlines.
  • Travel as necessary to attend job walks, pre-bid meetings and client conferences.
